verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֡וּא יִפְקֹ֣ד יְהוָה֩ בְּחַרְב֨וֹ הַקָּשָׁ֜ה וְהַגְּדוֹלָ֣ה וְהַֽחֲזָקָ֗ה עַ֤ל לִוְיָתָן֙ נָחָ֣שׁ בָּרִ֔חַ וְעַל֙ לִוְיָתָ֔ן נָחָ֖שׁ עֲקַלָּת֑וֹן וְהָרַ֥ג אֶת־ הַתַּנִּ֖ין אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּיָּֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū yip̄·qōḏ Yah·weh bə·ḥar·ḇō haq·qā·šāh wə·hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh wə·ha·ḥă·zā·qāh ‘al liw·yā·ṯān nā·ḥāš bā·ri·aḥ wə·‘al liw·yā·ṯān nā·ḥāš ‘ă·qal·lā·ṯō·wn wə·hā·raḡ ’eṯ- hat·tan·nîn ’ă·šer bay·yām
verses.literal: In that day the LORD will take His sharp great and mighty sword and bring judgment on Leviathan the fleeing . . . serpent Leviathan the coiling serpent and He will slay the dragon of the sea

verses.original: בַּיּ֖וֹם הַה֑וּא כֶּ֥רֶם חֶ֖מֶד עַנּוּ־ לָֽהּ׃
verses.literal: In that day Sing about a fruitful vineyard

verses.original: אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ נֹֽצְרָ֔הּ לִרְגָעִ֖ים אַשְׁקֶ֑נָּה פֶּ֚ן יִפְקֹ֣ד עָלֶ֔יהָ לַ֥יְלָה וָי֖וֹם אֶצֳּרֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî Yah·weh nō·ṣə·rāh lir·ḡā·‘îm ’aš·qen·nāh pen yip̄·qōḏ ‘ā·le·hā lay·lāh wā·yō·wm ’eṣ·ṣo·ren·nāh
verses.literal: I the LORD am its keeper I water it continually . . . I guard it night and day so no one can disturb it

verses.original: חֵמָ֖ה אֵ֣ין לִ֑י מִֽי־ יִתְּנֵ֜נִי שָׁמִ֥יר שַׁ֙יִת֙ בַּמִּלְחָמָ֔ה אֶפְשְׂעָ֥ה בָ֖הּ אֲצִיתֶ֥נָּה יָּֽחַד׃
verses.transliteration: ḥê·māh ’ên lî mî- yit·tə·nê·nî šā·mîr ša·yiṯ bam·mil·ḥā·māh ’ep̄·śə·‘āh ḇāh ’ă·ṣî·ṯen·nāh yā·ḥaḏ
verses.literal: I am not angry If only thorns and briers confronted Me I would march and trample them I would burn them to the ground

verses.original: א֚וֹ יַחֲזֵ֣ק בְּמָעוּזִּ֔י יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה שָׁל֖וֹם לִ֑י שָׁל֖וֹם יַֽעֲשֶׂה־ לִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw ya·ḥă·zêq bə·mā·‘ūz·zî ya·‘ă·śeh šā·lō·wm lî šā·lō·wm ya·‘ă·śeh- lî
verses.literal: Or let them lay claim to My protection let them make peace with Me yes, let them make peace with Me

verses.original: הַבָּאִים֙ יַשְׁרֵ֣שׁ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב יָצִ֥יץ וּפָרַ֖ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּמָלְא֥וּ פְנֵי־ תֵבֵ֖ל תְּנוּבָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: hab·bā·’îm yaš·rêš ya·‘ă·qōḇ yā·ṣîṣ ū·p̄ā·raḥ yiś·rā·’êl ū·mā·lə·’ū p̄ə·nê- ṯê·ḇêl tə·nū·ḇāh
verses.literal: In the days to come Jacob will take root Israel will bud and blossom and fill the whole world . . . with fruit

verses.original: הַכְּמַכַּ֥ת מַכֵּ֖הוּ הִכָּ֑הוּ אִם־ כְּהֶ֥רֶג הֲרֻגָ֖יו הֹרָֽג׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kə·mak·kaṯ mak·kê·hū hik·kā·hū ’im- kə·he·reḡ hă·ru·ḡāw hō·rāḡ
verses.literal: Has the LORD struck Israel as He struck her oppressors . . . Was she killed like those who slayed her . . .

verses.original: בְּסַּאסְּאָ֖ה בְּשַׁלְחָ֣הּ תְּרִיבֶ֑נָּה הָגָ֛ה בְּרוּח֥וֹ הַקָּשָׁ֖ה בְּי֥וֹם קָדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bə·sas·sə·’āh bə·šal·ḥāh tə·rî·ḇen·nāh hā·ḡāh bə·rū·ḥōw haq·qā·šāh bə·yō·wm qā·ḏîm
verses.literal: By warfare and exile You contended with her and removed her with a fierce wind as on the day the east wind blows

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן בְּזֹאת֙ יְכֻפַּ֣ר עֲוֺֽן־ יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְזֶ֕ה כָּל־ פְּרִ֖י הָסִ֣ר חַטָּאת֑וֹ בְּשׂוּמ֣וֹ׀ כָּל־ אַבְנֵ֣י מִזְבֵּ֗חַ כְּאַבְנֵי־ גִר֙ מְנֻפָּצ֔וֹת לֹֽא־ יָקֻ֥מוּ אֲשֵׁרִ֖ים וְחַמָּנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên bə·zōṯ yə·ḵup·par ‘ă·wōn- ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·zeh kāl- pə·rî hā·sir ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw bə·śū·mōw kāl- ’aḇ·nê miz·bê·aḥ kə·’aḇ·nê- ḡir mə·nup·pā·ṣō·wṯ lō- yā·qu·mū ’ă·šê·rîm wə·ḥam·mā·nîm
verses.literal: Therefore . . . Jacob’s guilt will be atoned for and the full fruit of the removal of his sin will be this When he makes all the altar . . . stones like crushed bits of chalk no Asherah poles or incense altars will remain standing

verses.original: כִּ֣י עִ֤יר בְּצוּרָה֙ בָּדָ֔ד נָוֶ֕ה מְשֻׁלָּ֥ח וְנֶעֱזָ֖ב כַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר שָׁ֣ם יִרְעֶ֥ה עֵ֛גֶל וְשָׁ֥ם יִרְבָּ֖ץ וְכִלָּ֥ה סְעִפֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ‘îr bə·ṣū·rāh bā·ḏāḏ nā·weh mə·šul·lāḥ wə·ne·‘ĕ·zāḇ kam·miḏ·bār šām yir·‘eh ‘ê·ḡel wə·šām yir·bāṣ wə·ḵil·lāh sə·‘i·p̄e·hā
verses.literal: For the fortified city lies deserted a homestead abandoned a wilderness forsaken There the calves graze and there they lie down they strip its branches bare

verses.original: בִּיבֹ֤שׁ קְצִירָהּ֙ תִּשָּׁבַ֔רְנָה נָשִׁ֕ים בָּא֖וֹת מְאִיר֣וֹת אוֹתָ֑הּ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א עַם־ בִּינוֹת֙ ה֔וּא עַל־ כֵּן֙ לֹֽא־ יְרַחֲמֶ֣נּוּ עֹשֵׂ֔הוּ וְיֹצְר֖וֹ לֹ֥א יְחֻנֶּֽנּוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: bî·ḇōš qə·ṣî·rāh tiš·šā·ḇar·nāh nā·šîm bā·’ō·wṯ mə·’î·rō·wṯ ’ō·w·ṯāh kî lō ‘am- bî·nō·wṯ hū ‘al- kên lō- yə·ra·ḥă·men·nū ‘ō·śê·hū wə·yō·ṣə·rōw lō yə·ḥun·nen·nū
verses.literal: When its limbs are dry they are broken off Women come and use them for kindling for this is a people without understanding Therefore . . . their Maker has no compassion on them and their Creator shows them no favor

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יַחְבֹּ֧ט יְהוָ֛ה מִשִּׁבֹּ֥לֶת הַנָּהָ֖ר עַד־ נַ֣חַל מִצְרָ֑יִם וְאַתֶּ֧ם תְּלֻקְּט֛וּ לְאַחַ֥ד אֶחָ֖ד בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bay·yō·wm ha·hū yaḥ·bōṭ Yah·weh miš·šib·bō·leṯ han·nā·hār ‘aḏ- na·ḥal miṣ·rā·yim wə·’at·tem tə·luq·qə·ṭū lə·’a·ḥaḏ ’e·ḥāḏ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: In that day the LORD will thresh from the flowing Euphrates to the Wadi of Egypt and you O Israelites . . . will be gathered one by one

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִתָּקַע֮ בְּשׁוֹפָ֣ר גָּדוֹל֒ וּבָ֗אוּ הָאֹֽבְדִים֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אַשּׁ֔וּר וְהַנִּדָּחִ֖ים בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהִשְׁתַּחֲו֧וּ לַיהוָ֛ה בְּהַ֥ר הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bay·yō·wm ha·hū yit·tā·qa‘ bə·šō·w·p̄ār gā·ḏō·wl ū·ḇā·’ū hā·’ō·ḇə·ḏîm bə·’e·reṣ ’aš·šūr wə·han·nid·dā·ḥîm bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim wə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wū Yah·weh bə·har haq·qō·ḏeš bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: And in that day a great ram’s horn will sound and those who were perishing in Assyria will come forth with those who were exiles in Egypt And they will worship the LORD on the holy mountain in Jerusalem
